assembly_notes: Seven independent structural slots and no multiplicity: a pedal has one board, one cam and one beater. frame_style provides the heel hinge, the rocker axis and the clamp seat; board_style consumes the heel hinge and republishes a drive station whose position is derived from host capacity (it walks back along the board until the coupling has a real run to the cam lug); cam_style consumes the rocker axis and publishes both the drive lug and a beater seat offset in y so every beater clears the rim. All 2 x 3 x 4 x 2 x 3 x 2 x 2 = 864 combinations build with no compatibility gate. The flexible drive members are modelled as rigid parts anchored on the cam lug rather than on the board, because a rigid member fixed to the board would sweep through the cam when the board is pressed; the board carries the matching drive lug so the coupling still spans board and cam. Both hinge seats and the clamp seat are real clevises with stub pins, and the rocker shaft is journalled either side of the cam hub instead of running through it.

derived.expression: the clevis cheeks sit at +-(board_width_m/2 + 0.0075) with stub pins that stop 0.0005 short of the board eye
derived.name: hinge_clevis_gap_m
derived.rationale: the board must swing in real clearance, not through a solid block

derived.expression: the shaft is journalled in two stubs outside the hub half length
derived.name: hub_half_m
derived.rationale: the shaft may not run through the solid hub

derived.expression: the coupling runs from the lug toward the board drive station and covers 0.34 of that run
derived.name: drive_run_m
derived.rationale: the coupling is sized from the real shaft-to-board geometry

derived.expression: the beater and the height carriage ride at y = cam_width/2 + 0.012
derived.name: beater_offset_y_m
derived.rationale: the beater must clear the cam rim through the whole rotation

derived.expression: the clamp lever swings between cheeks at +-0.026 on stub pins
derived.name: clamp_cheek_y_m
derived.rationale: the clamp lever needs a clevis, not a solid bridge

derived.expression: the bracket stops 0.008 short of the spring own clamp block
derived.name: spring_y_m
derived.rationale: the spring hangs outboard of the upright without biting into it
